name: Lady Luck's Due
source:
After winning the 50 thousand dollar jackpot and rushing out of the casino Guy finds himself in a bit of trouble. Sent into a state of limbo, he meets Lady Luck who informs him that the only way to save himself is to play Black Jack; one hand, no questions asked, and no crying."


[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231208061654/https://castingdreams.itch.io/ladylucksdue]itch.io[/url]]
